decision: REJECTED as default; kept as documented per-workload knob
finding: k=5 wins at concurrency on mixed/prose prompts (+5-7% c2/c4) because dropped positions 6-7 carried only ~11% of accepted tokens. But structured (0.918-acceptance) loses ~2 tokens/step -> -19%. The scheduled-token clamp stays 1024 even at k=5, so k<7 does NOT relax the C6 budget either.
recommendation: DFLASH_TOKENS is workload-dependent: keep 7 (shipping default) for structured/high-acceptance traffic; k=5 only for prose-heavy concurrent serving. Not re-pinned.
